direction_convention: SOURCE describes its relationship to TARGET; derived artifact points to its source or supporting evidence.
accepted_edge_requirements: source_artifact_id resolves to exactly one D5.1 logical node
target_artifact_id resolves to exactly one D5.1 logical node
evidence names a manifest, receipt, contract, audit, or evidence artifact
no filename, folder, or guess-only relationship is accepted
cycle_policy: Accepted lineage graph must be a DAG. Synthetic cycle fixtures remain in-memory only.
